F01-future-sle-repeatable-read-corruptio.fix_summary: Prepared master lookups before rollback+lock, captured posting_date/posting_time after lock_stock_coordinates(), and attached re-entrant before_submit locks to all 6 stock doctypes in hooks.py.
F01-future-sle-repeatable-read-corruptio.summary: proven_empty_future_sle_fastpath can read a stale REPEATABLE READ MVCC snapshot opened before lock_stock_coordinates() and capture posting_time before locking; native Desk stock doctypes also lack before_submit stock locks.

F02-voucher-fastpath-multithread-and-laz.fix_summary: Replaced global teardown dicts with idempotent closure-bound dispatchers capturing original callables permanently per attribute, eliminating NoneType/RecursionError/lazy-import worker poisoning.
F02-voucher-fastpath-multithread-and-laz.summary: voucher_fastpath.py global dicts cleared on release can poison lazily-imported modules or race with concurrent threads under Gunicorn --threads=12.

F03-perf-parity-oracle-cache-sidecar-per.fix_summary: Failed closed when --oracle-cache-dir is combined with --runner exec and added prepare_sidecar_oracle_cache_dir() to ensure UID 1000 sidecar write permissions.
F03-perf-parity-oracle-cache-sidecar-per.summary: tools/perf_parity.py creates --oracle-cache-dir with host umask causing PermissionError in UID 1000 sidecar, and fails to reject --oracle-cache-dir with --runner exec.

F04-perf-parity-db-fingerprint-misses-va.fix_summary: Extended capture_db_fingerprint() with Repost Item Valuation, SLE value/qty aggregates, and SII/DN/Packed/Bundle/Item metadata, plus external --oracle-manifest trust root.
F04-perf-parity-db-fingerprint-misses-va.summary: capture_db_fingerprint() omits Repost Item Valuation, SLE value/qty aggregates, and SII/DN/Packed/Bundle/Item metadata, allowing stale oracle cache hits after valuation reposts.

F05-autopay-fastpath-loose-tolerance-and.fix_summary: Enforced <=1e-9 exact equality on paid_amount, payment_total, base_paid_amount, and base_payable_total plus loyalty_amount==0 guard before skipping 2nd calculate_taxes_and_totals().
F05-autopay-fastpath-loose-tolerance-and.summary: _can_fast_sync_autopay_totals() allows 0.005 tolerance (5 units at precision=3) and omits loyalty_amount == 0 and base_paid_amount parity checks.

F06-validate-items-permission-fastpath-g.fix_summary: Added has_permission hook check, if_owner role permission fail-closed check, and applicable_for='Item' User Permission check to _item_permission_restrictions_active().
F06-validate-items-permission-fastpath-g.summary: _item_permission_restrictions_active() skips has_permission hooks for Item, if_owner role permissions, and User Permissions with applicable_for='Item'.

F07-perf-bench-inner-duplicate-sale-item.fix_summary: Changed build_sale_payload() to use rng.sample() without replacement when pool_len >= line_count so 10/50/200-line benchmark sales have distinct item_codes.
F07-perf-bench-inner-duplicate-sale-item.summary: build_sale_payload() samples items with replacement, creating duplicate item_codes on 50/200-line sales and silently disabling proven_empty_future_sle_fastpath during inner-loop benchmarks.

F08-happy-path-rollback-breaks-savepoint.fix_summary: Guarded _run_idempotent() rollback on transaction_writes == 0 (failing closed on fresh_snapshot=False otherwise) and switched capture_with_rollback()/_profile_rollback_action() to clean transaction rollback without SAVEPOINT 1305 errors.
F08-happy-path-rollback-breaks-savepoint.summary: Unconditional frappe.db.rollback() in _run_idempotent() destroys MariaDB SAVEPOINTs in perf_parity/perf_bench_inner and can wipe outer uncommitted transaction writes.

F09-oracle-manifest-dir-chown-chmod-shar.fix_summary: Refused sticky/shared system directories (like /tmp, /var/tmp, /) as --oracle-manifest parent and prevented chown/chmod on sticky/shared directories.
F09-oracle-manifest-dir-chown-chmod-shar.summary: tools/perf_parity.py::host_exec() runs chown/chmod on manifest_path.parent which can mutate or strip the sticky bit on /tmp.

goal: Optimize Khitmee backend for full seasonal load on 2GiB RAM / 2 vCPU VPS while dramatically accelerating exact parity verification and dev inner-loop velocity
grill_summary: Full-stack 3-shard swarm from origin/main (84667da): (1) fast_verify accelerates exact oracle parity and inner-loop rollback-safe profiling; (2) cashier_backend optimizes write-path CPU/SQL, deadlock-safe Bin/Item locking, search latency, and 2GiB/2vCPU runtime profile while keeping ERPNext core untouched and single global invoice naming series; (3) manager_parity productionizes PR #16 ordered invoice detail and full-year CSV export parity into khitmee_ops. Coordinator=Neon High, Workers=Neon Medium, Deep Reviewer=Neon High, merge_mode=human.
